text:
taylor: RC 0.18.0 is blocked — regen produced a typegen diff that flips a required field to optional and sample-app auth tests started failing. Semver guard also blocked publish because CHANGELOG entry was auto-labeled as minor. Anyone triaging?
kim: paste CI link please
taylor: https://ci.internal/17450 job 11
taylor: Diff snippet:
```
- export interface CreateSession { userId: string; token: string; expiresAt: string }
+ export interface CreateSession { token: string; expiresAt?: string; userId: string }
```
josh: Oof. Generator heuristics seem to treat some fields as optional now. That explains auth retry flakiness when client omits expiresAt. Two-pronged fix: 1) force generator to preserve "required" semantics (flag/pin), 2) regen and run sample-app full smoke.
changelog-bot: Note: CHANGELOG auto-classified PRs labelled "chore" as minor by default. Manual changelog edits may be overwritten.
taylor: We must avoid spec edits. Also we shouldn't let auto-changelog turn this into a minor feature. We need a patch release with a clear note: "patch(sdk): regen parity - required field preservation".
kim: Plan: open PR with tools/typegen config -> "preserveRequired": true and explicit generator version pin, regenerate types, update package type-hash, add a one-line CHANGELOG entry under patch, run `yarn sample-app:test --ci` locally, then push. Add PR label `chore/regen` and `release:patch`.
josh: If changelog-bot will overwrite, add `changelog-bot:manual-override` tag in PR body and ping release-ops to approve the wording.
ci-bot: publish-gate: blocked - metadata/typehash mismatch. Re-run after PR will validate.
release-ops: If CI still flakes after PR, request release exception with justification "non-user-facing SDK parity/regenerator heuristic change" and include before/after diffs and smoke-run logs.
taylor: I'll open PR in ~10m, include exact regen command and before/after type-hash, and tag @kim @josh. Will run: `yarn tools:typegen --preserve-required --generator-version=2.3.1 && yarn sample-app:test --ci`.
kim: Thanks — will review changelog text and trigger release-ops if needed. :thumbsup:
